name: colmap-wasm
description: Unofficial WebAssembly build of COLMAP 4.2.1 (SIFT, geometric verification, view-graph calibration, global mapper) for the browser, with exact SIFT matching on WebGPU
author: Bryan Diniz

scripts.prepack: node -e "for (const f of ['wasm/colmap.wasm','dist/index.js']) if (!require('fs').existsSync(f)) { console.error('missing ' + f + ': run build:wasm and build first'); process.exit(1) }"
scripts.site:build: npm run build && vite build --config site/vite.config.ts
scripts.site:deploy: npm run site:build && wrangler deploy --config site/wrangler.jsonc
